name: Spotify Playlist Sync
description: Sync your Spotify playlists into Matinee. Tracks are matched against your music libraries, songs you don't have appear as greyed-out 'not available' entries.
author: Michael André Reber

config.label: Spotify Client ID
config.description: Create an app at developer.spotify.com and add the Redirect URI shown in the Connection row below.

config.label: Spotify Client Secret
config.description: Leave empty to use PKCE, which is recommended.

config.label: Playlist owner (Matinee username)
config.description: Synced playlists are created for this Matinee account.

config.label: Playlists to sync
config.description: Only playlists you own or collaborate on are listed. Spotify no longer serves other people's tracks over its API. Save after changing the selection.
